answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 422 Country: Pakistan Title: I am 19 year old currently living in karachi, Pakistan. I want to know whether it is feasible or not to attain Higher Education in London in islamic perspective? Question: I am 19 year old currently living in karachi, Pakistan. I want to know whether it is feasible or not to attain Higher Education in London in islamic perspective? Answer ID: 422 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 239=230/M) If you can afford education there, your parents allow it and this does not cause you to leave any Shariah matter or commit any sinful act then you can acquire higher education in London. There is nothing wrong from Islamic perspective. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
